original_test_intent: Exercise PCIe equalization 10,000 times on each approved endpoint path and verify every retrain returns to the expected generation/width with acceptable errors and no cumulative instability.
original_method: Pin vendor equalization module/config; map allowlisted bridges/ports/endpoints and exclude critical shared paths; baseline link/AER/driver/I/O; approve phase/equalization settings, loop meaning/timing and acceptance; drain I/O; run monitored loops with first-failure stop; restore and verify all endpoints/services.
manual_activity: PCIe owner authorizes exact ports and equalization semantics during a maintenance window; operator protects I/O and owns OOB recovery.
required_inputs: I/O drain, abort and OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Never equalize every bridge without resolved topology
Stop on first failed retrain, AER, I/O or management anomaly
No guessed command or automatic retry
Preserve failing loop and link state
agent_execution_scope: Run one bounded allowlisted loop campaign

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The guessed pcie_eq token lacks topology, equalization phase/settings and per-loop criteria.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned vendor module on explicit safe ports with per-loop retrain verification.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal 10,000 equalization loops and all intended endpoints are retained, subject to an approved safe allowlist.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Log each port's generation/width/equalization state and AER delta for every loop, stopping at first non-recovery.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds topology exclusions, objective loop result and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Firmware/readability does not prove equalization endurance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Retraining shared PCIe hierarchies can interrupt unrelated endpoints and accumulate errors.

project_override_considerations: Platform topology owner defines which bridges are isolated enough for repeated equalization and whether 10,000 applies per port or total.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure requires 10,000 disruptive equalization loops; Criteria only check readable text and firmware.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A safe allowlist and vendor semantics can be provisioned; otherwise the individual execution remains blocked.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row311 Wistron-NV GPU-00304-V003: approve exact equalization module/config, safe bridge/port/endpoint allowlist, phase/settings, 10,000-loop meaning, per-loop speed/width/equalization/error oracle and recovery; map or replace unrelated Criteria.

review_improvement: Makes repeated equalization a topology-bounded endurance test with a first-failure stop instead of a generic proprietary invocation.
independent_technical_reasoning: PCIe equalization retrains the physical link and may affect every downstream function on a shared hierarchy. Counting command completions is insufficient; every cycle must demonstrate restored generation/width and no new error condition before the next cycle.
